title: Reading Drill — Recovering a Lost Footpath
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: Recovering a Lost Footpath
passages.body:
**A** A village wanted to reopen a path shown on old maps. To find the route, volunteers compared a map with aerial photographs showing long strips of uncultivated land.

**B** A farmer confirmed that one strip had once been walked but explained why the path had moved well before the map was printed. This made oral evidence useful alongside the images.

**C** The new path skirted an active field. At the entrance, signs explained the difference between the historic route and the current route, so walkers would not cross crops.
